checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Eyes, nose, mouth, jaw and proportions look the same; very slight sharpening only.
Skin keeps visible texture and freckles/moles; not airbrushed, though slightly cleaner.
Curls and subtle closed smile are preserved; hair slightly darker/glossier.

must.item: Park replaced with unobtrusive backdrop, flattering lighting
must.why: Neutral grey studio backdrop, soft even light.

faults.what: Slight cleanup of skin and a subtle shift in tone/contrast and hair darkness; very minor.
Fine flyaway hair edges look slightly synthetic against the backdrop.

summary: A faithful professional headshot with the same face, texture and curls, now in a navy blazer on a neutral grey backdrop, with only tiny polish differences.
